uncertain.text: εἴς τι l. ἔν τινι / τινὸς ἔν τινι
uncertain.note: Each mark is a breathing combined with an accent, and the breathing looks smooth. I changed the OCR's εἰς/ἕν to εἴς/ἔν, but the glyphs are small.
The combined breathing and accent mark matches the one in strip 04. I read it as εἴς, where the OCR had εἷς.
The diaeresis is almost entirely cut off at the top edge of the strip, with only faint traces visible. I kept Ö.
